about: What the owner's uploads can never show, listed under the brief as 'could not check'. The server adds these after the Verifier (lib/verifier-checks.ts), so every brief is honest about its limits. 'unless' skips an item when the uploaded rows already cover it (a regular expression, case-insensitive, over the named fields). 'when_empty' items appear only when that table has no rows.

reason.en: We cannot see your CCRIS or CTOS report. Lenders read it first; pull your free CTOS report before you apply.
reason.ms: Kami tidak dapat melihat laporan CCRIS atau CTOS anda. Pemberi pinjaman membacanya dahulu; dapatkan laporan CTOS percuma sebelum memohon.

item.en: Card and QR fee rates in your merchant agreement
item.ms: Kadar caj kad dan QR dalam perjanjian peniaga anda

reason.en: We measured what the bank actually settled, not the rate your acquirer agreed to. Check your merchant agreement.
reason.ms: Kami mengukur jumlah yang benar-benar dimasukkan oleh bank, bukan kadar yang dipersetujui oleh pemeroleh anda. Semak perjanjian peniaga anda.

item.en: Whether your landlord charges SST on rent
item.ms: Sama ada tuan rumah mengenakan SST atas sewa

reason.en: Rental is a taxed service (8%) only if the landlord is SST-registered; your files don't say.
reason.ms: Sewa ialah perkhidmatan bercukai (8%) hanya jika tuan rumah berdaftar SST; fail anda tidak menyatakannya.

item.ms: Kontrak pembekal dan harga yang dipersetujui

reason.en: We see invoices, not the terms behind them, so we cannot tell whether a price rise breaks an agreement.
reason.ms: Kami melihat invois, bukan terma di sebaliknya, jadi kami tidak dapat menentukan sama ada kenaikan harga melanggar perjanjian.

item.en: Payroll and rent as line items

reason.en: No payroll or rent records were uploaded; we only see the months your bank statement covers.
reason.ms: Tiada rekod gaji atau sewa dimuat naik; kami hanya melihat bulan yang diliputi oleh penyata bank anda.

reason.en: No list of bills paid was uploaded.
reason.ms: Tiada senarai bil yang telah dibayar dimuat naik.

item.ms: Terma pembekal dan notis perubahan harga
